correctness.rationale: For positive part sizes in the independent-set five-cycle blow-up and pure uncolored adjacency language, the four-move EF game is invariant under size clipping at four: before the kth move each named part has fewer than four occupied clones, so Duplicator can preserve equality and adjacency using unused clones in corresponding parts. The exact recursive quantifier-rank type T_{r+1}=(atomic diagram, set of one-vertex extension T_r types) enumerates all possible moves up to permutations of unused clones. I independently coded this type recurrence (not the repository's verify_c5.py) and enumerated all 4^5=1024 clipped size vectors; recovered exactly 33 distinct rank-four empty-tuple types, class-minimum-size frequencies 5:1,6:1,7:3,8:4,9:7,10:7,11:6,12:2,13:1,15:1, and 3-clipping equivalence for every clipped vector. Combined with the analytic four-clipping, this is exhaustive for all positive sizes, not a finite extrapolation. The unique class needing 15 vertices is all sizes at least three. Reviewed actual RESULT.md, verify_c5.py and Git table presence; computed independent census. Does not apply to named parts, counting quantifiers, empty parts or rank >=5.
